spec.description: Resolve a latitude/longitude to the forecast grid it falls in. Almost every other endpoint here is addressed by grid cell rather than by coordinates, so this is where a caller starts: it returns the office and the grid indices `forecast.get_forecast` takes, plus the zones, the radar station and the nearest city.

latitude.description: Latitude in WGS 84 decimal degrees. The service rounds to four decimal places and redirects anything longer, so pass no more precision than that.

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS 84 decimal degrees, negative west of the prime meridian.

response.title: PointFeature
response.description: The grid point, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in. The geometry is the coordinates you asked about, so the client hands back `properties`.

geometry.description: The coordinates that were resolved, rounded.

cwa.description: County warning area: the three-letter code of the office responsible, such as `SEW`. Identical to `gridId`.

gridId.description: Forecast office code addressing the grid, such as `SEW`. Pass this as `office` to the `forecast` endpoints.

forecast.description: URL of the twice-daily forecast for this cell.

forecastHourly.description: URL of the hourly forecast for this cell.

forecastGridData.description: URL of the raw gridded data both forecasts are rendered from.

observationStations.description: URL of the stations that observe this cell.

forecastZone.description: URL of the forecast zone the point is in.

county.description: URL of the county zone the point is in.

fireWeatherZone.description: URL of the fire-weather zone the point is in.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the point, such as `America/Los_Angeles`. Forecast period times are in this zone.

radarStation.description: Identifier of the radar covering the point, such as `KATX`.

relativeLocation.title: RelativeLocationFeature
relativeLocation.description: The nearest named place, as its own GeoJSON feature.

properties.title: RelativeLocation
properties.description: Which place, and how far away.

distance.description: Distance from the point to that city.

bearing.description: Bearing from that city to the point, in degrees clockwise from true north.

notes: The service redirects a request whose coordinates carry more than four decimal places, so the client rounds nothing and passes what the caller gave: over-precise coordinates are the caller's to fix, and the redirect says so.
